positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design, implement, and test embedded software interfaces supporting real-time sensing, inertial modeling, simulated inputs, and deterministic data flows across integrated subsystems.
• Build and maintain emulator-based and hardware-in-the-loop test environments, developing Python-driven functional tests to validate data propagation, timing alignment, configuration behavior, and system stability.
• Modernize and support CI/CD pipelines and build infrastructure, including containerized build environments, automated artifact packaging, dependency validation, and secure release workflows.
• Diagnose and resolve complex integration issues across software components, improving reliability through enhanced configuration management, structured metadata handling, and systematic regression verification.
• Collaborate across systems, hardware, firmware, and software teams to develop clear interface definitions, secure communication paths, and production-ready embedded solutions.
• Utilized infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools to standardize development environments across multiple networks, ensuring consistency and repeatability in deployment
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to design and implement CI/CD pipelines that met customer-defined standards for code quality, security, and resiliency, improving overall delivery speed and reliability
• Deployed GitLab runners to automate testing, building, and deployment of software applications, ensuring seamless integration with CI/CD pipelines
• Implemented security best practices into CI/CD pipelines, including vulnerability scanning, SBOM generation and validation, and code review, to ensure the delivery of secure software applications
• Worked closely with multiple stakeholders across various development groups, sharing knowledge and expertise to drive process improvements and optimize DevSecOps practices
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · C++ · Kubernetes · Gitlab · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Agile Methodologies · Podman · DAST · SAST · Sonarqube · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) · Embedded Linux · Bash

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Optimize data preprocessing algorithms for information retrieval tasks and deep learning data loaders
• Adapt NN architectures for: lay language Q&A over federal regulations and legal documents with natural 
language processing, classification of satellite imagery, and image augmentation of midfrequency active 
sonar
• Develop experiments and pipelines for testing deep learning solutions against well-defined baselines with 
domain specific metrics to measure network performance
• Perform feature analysis, selection, and classifier tuning in collaboration with project SME
• Manage bare-metal deep learning and processing servers, networks, monitoring solutions, VPNs, and 
firewall configurations for multiple site locations
• Maintain DNS, VCS, CI/CD pipelines, and authentication control for internal services using Infrastructure as 
Code (IaC) methodology
• Develop documentation, policy, and plans for NIST-SP 800-53 and NIST-SP 800-171 compliance
• Conduct and oversee information system audits in compliance with NIST-SP 800-53 and NIST-SP 800-171
